learnings: Tool errors (LLM response failures) should trigger automatic retry or fallback rather than marking files as inconclusive
When one model completes a full review successfully with no findings while others have tool errors, the successful review should carry appropriate weight
Advisory reports for different package versions should be clearly separated from current version audits to avoid confusion
Infrastructure failures should not be conflated with security uncertainty in the final verdict
